1.t: When the sky is ripped apart,

2.t: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,

3.t: when the earth is levelled out,

4.t: casts out its contents, and becomes empty,

5.t: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,

6.t: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him:

7.t: whoever is given his record in his right hand

9.t: and return to his people well pleased,

10.t: but whoever is given his record from behind his back

12.t: he will burn in the blazing Fire.

13.t: He used to live among his people well pleased.

14.t: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––

15.t: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him.

16.t: I swear by the glow of sunset,

17.t: by the night and what it covers,

19.t: you will progress from stage to stage.

20.t: So why do they not believe?

21.t: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]?

22.t: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––

23.t: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––

24.t: so give them news of a painful torment.

25.t: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward.
